links.outcome: Concordance of LLM psoriasis treatment answers with 2021 AAD-NPF guidelines, by recommendation strength
links.effect: Both models 87.1% overall concordance; fully aligned with strong recommendations; moderate: ChatGPT 87.5% vs DeepSeek 81.3%; limited: DeepSeek 66.7% vs ChatGPT 33.3%.
links.quote: Both ChatGPT and DeepSeek demonstrated an overall concordance rate of 87.1%.

screen.reason: Evaluates the adherence and concordance of ChatGPT-4 and DeepSeek responses to clinical guidelines for psoriasis treatment without testing an organizational deployment safeguard or practice.
